status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

ticketRanking.win: strict-OOS Elo/decay horse probability times JRA official win odds
ticketRanking.wide: product of the two strict-OOS Elo/decay horse probabilities times JRA official wide lower-bound odds
ticketRanking.quinella: product of the two strict-OOS Elo/decay horse probabilities times JRA official quinella odds

raceFeatures: pre-race summaries of top ticket scores/official odds/model-market divergence plus surface,distance,class,field size,race number,track condition; no outcomes
coldStartFirst30Dates: rank by mean of top-three pre-race ticket scores across win/wide/quinella
diagnostic: full-history ROI and largest-ticket-removed ROI; no post-result threshold changes
